purpose: Source-derived technical inventory of fields and flows that can contain, inherit, reference or accidentally receive potentially sensitive student information. It prepares SENSITIVE_DATA_TREATMENT review without deciding final legal classification, legal basis, necessity, retention, consent, disclosure or incident obligations.

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Objective and free-form/context-like fields can reveal limitations, health context or other sensitive information depending on actual content.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: collect only fields necessary for the coaching workflow
avoid placing health or injury narrative in general profile fields when a narrower structured field would suffice
keep organization/tenant isolation and purpose boundaries
do not copy student profile content into growth, advertising or engineering receipts

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Prescription notes, lineage reasons and trigger context can encode injury, pain, limitation or other sensitive coaching context.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: avoid unnecessary diagnostic or clinical narrative
limit lineage context to what is necessary to explain the training decision
do not reuse prescription context for advertising or unrelated analytics
preserve human review for consequential coaching changes

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Pain score/location, exertion, energy and free-form feedback are explicit high-sensitivity candidates in the product context.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: collect only the feedback needed for training follow-up
do not infer diagnosis from pain or energy fields
do not place feedback content in UTMs, advertising payloads or unnecessary logs
separate student feedback from growth and billing purposes

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Decision Intelligence inputs/outputs can inherit sensitive context from student, training and feedback data even when the table has no health-specific column name.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: include only context necessary for the specific coach decision
preserve human-in-the-loop decision authority
do not send sensitive context to a future external AI provider before privacy/security/provider gates are satisfied
avoid copying full source records when a bounded summary or derived signal is sufficient

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Coach action notes can reproduce sensitive student context even if the originating field was elsewhere.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: store only action context necessary for follow-up and audit
avoid duplicating full pain/injury narratives
do not use action notes as marketing attributes
keep tenant-scoped access controls

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Security telemetry can identify or link a student even when it should not contain coaching/health content; alert delivery creates a boundary where over-sharing must be prevented.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: use identifiers/fingerprints and bounded event metadata instead of workout or health narrative
do not place raw tokens or secrets in receipts/alerts
do not place pain, injury or workout-note content in external alert payloads
retain only event fields needed for security detection, investigation and reviewed retention

table_backed_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Attribution and marketing fields could accidentally receive sensitive free text or derived health/fitness targeting if ingestion boundaries are not enforced.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: never encode pain, injury, health, workout notes or sensitive student context into UTM/source/term/content values
do not use sensitive student information for ad targeting
keep growth events non-authoritative for external readiness
use minimum approved identifiers and event names only after applicable privacy/marketing review

non_table_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Users may voluntarily send sensitive content in support or rights-request channels even when the product did not request it.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: request only information necessary to authenticate and resolve the request
warn against sending unnecessary health or workout detail
separate request identity proof from unrelated support content
avoid copying raw sensitive submissions into engineering receipts

source_document_markers: Proteger tenants e dados potencialmente sensíveis
non_table_surfaces.risk_mechanism: Incident investigation can expand access/copying of sensitive student content unless blast-radius and evidence collection are minimized.
technical_minimization_requirements_for_: inspect no more personal data than necessary to establish incident facts
use minimized references/digests where possible
do not copy secrets or unrelated tenant data into incident records
exercise sensitive-data scenarios only with synthetic/non-customer fixtures until real authority exists

observed_access_control_context.interpretation: These are bounded technical observations. They do not prove legal minimization sufficiency, all access paths, or final sensitive-data treatment readiness.
